title: The Regent's Writ has inconsistent stated requirements from two different NPCs. Preceptor Aldous at Cinderhall's Ironbound chapterhouse says 'Burn two hollows clean, and it's yours. One doesn't count for much,' and the Iron Downs quest log read 'The Ironbound will write the writ once two have burned' while I had only burned one (Thornwold). But the Marrowgate envoy at Highward's Captain-General's Hall granted the same writ immediately after asking 'Have you done either yet?' with only that one burned hollow to my name ('A hollow put to the fire is proof enough for the Regent. The writ is yours.').
where: Cinderhall chapterhouse (Preceptor Aldous) vs. Captain-General's Hall (Marrowgate envoy) — Regent's Writ
